intent: Count how many of the five specified product variants have at least 4 units available today in the downtown Ljubljana PowerTool store.

params.fam_festool: Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag
params.fam_heco: Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer

success_criteria: Downtown Ljubljana PowerTool store resolved to exactly one store_id
Each of the five product variants resolved by product_family_name plus its distinguishing variant properties
Availability filtered to store_inventory.available_today_quantity >= 4 for that store
Final answer is the count of qualifying variants in exact format 'Count: %d'
refs cite the record_path of every available (>=4) matched product

args.stdin: SELECT store_id, record_path, store_name, city, is_open FROM stores WHERE city = :city AND store_name LIKE :store_pattern;

WITH lj_store AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM stores
  WHERE city = :city AND store_name LIKE :store_pattern
),
target_skus AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
  WHERE
    (pf.product_family_name = :fam_festool
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'storage_type' AND p.property_value_text = :storage_type))
    OR (pf.product_family_name = :fam_heco
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'fastener_type' AND p.property_value_text = :fastener_threaded))
    OR (pf.product_family_name = :fam_heco
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'fastener_type' AND p.property_value_text = :fastener_bolt)
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p2 WHERE p2.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p2.property_key = 'diameter_mm' AND p2.property_value_number = :diameter))
    OR (pf.product_family_name = :fam_ajax
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND p.property_value_text = :cleaner_degreaser))
    OR (pf.product_family_name = :fam_ajax
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'cleaner_type' AND p.property_value_text = :cleaner_floor))
)
SELECT ts.product_sku, ts.record_path, si.available_today_quantity
FROM target_skus ts
JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = ts.product_sku
JOIN lj_store ls ON ls.store_id = si.store_id
WHERE si.available_today_quantity >= :min_available;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
